palette.$description: The Ink and mint sticker palette, strength B (the engineer, 2026-10-20, docs/ui-decisions.md, pages/sticker/). An entry marked (agent) is a shade the agent derived inside the palette for a state.

ink.$description: The ink: every outline, the hard shadow under stickers, text on mint and on the bright faces.

purple-deep.$description: The full-screen ground (the end screen, menus over nothing).

purple-light.$description: (agent) A lighter purple: the hover fill on purple and a setting row's face.

mint.$description: Plates: HUD plates, fields, cards and the selected tab; text on purple.

mint-light.$description: (agent) Mint lifted: the hover face of a mint sticker.

mint-dark.$description: (agent) Mint pressed: the held face of a mint sticker, a hover fill on mint.

green.$description: The alien green: the main action, the selected chip, titles on purple, health and progress.

green-light.$description: (agent) The green lifted: the hover face of the main action.

green-dark.$description: (agent) The green pressed: the held face of the main action.

coral.$description: Alarm: danger buttons, alert stickers, the anger bar.

coral-light.$description: (agent) The coral lifted: the hover face of a danger button.

coral-dark.$description: (agent) The coral pressed: the held face of a danger button and the you-are-here pin.

muted.$description: Dim text on purple; the unplugged (disabled) face.

ink-soft.$description: (agent) Dim text on mint and on the bright faces; the unplugged outline and label.

backdrop.$description: The deep purple over the world behind menus.

backdrop-deep.$description: The deep purple over the world behind dialogs.

zone.$description: A zone tint on the map.

logo.$description: The cartoon face, on the logo only, at its default instance.

extrabold.$description: Text (Nunito), as the sticker page sets its labels and rows.

black.$description: Titles, buttons, tabs, chips and bold text (Nunito Black).

press.$description: The CSS image of Godot's TRANS_SINE + EASE_OUT (Tween has no cubic-bezier).

stroke.$description: Strength B: every sticker outline is 4 px of ink.

offset.$description: The hard ink shadow of strength B: a base layer 5 px right and 5 px down (no StyleBoxFlat shadow; spec decision 4).

space.$description: The separations of the screens' rows, columns and grids (the only gaps a screen uses).
